title: MineClash
description: A Mod Which Brings ClashRoyale's Characters Into Minecraft!
body:
![ClashRoyale!!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d699fa7b4afaa44b6ba1e0eadf6c444c896059b1.jpeg)
# What would happen if Clash Royale meets Minecraft?
This mod is dedicated to every player who loves CLASHROYALE and MINECRAFT!

Mineclash adds many mobs based on Clash Royale's Classic characters such as PEKKA,Knight and Valkyrie,makes Minecraft world more colourful!
## With Mineclash Mod,You Can:
- Collecting Resources
- Craft and Upgrade cards(WIP)
- Summon Clash Royale Troops, Buildings, and Spells
- Organize your own unique army
- fight against enemies(Monsters or other Players)
 
**Two kings enter,and one king exit!**
